case.pattern_description: Card-not-present fraud with post-compromise card testing: customer dispute on $30.02 purchase followed by 9 rapid small-value online transactions totaling $330.12 within 72 hours. Desktop device fingerprint shows partial identity match (id_34=match_status:2) and address mismatch (id_12=NotFound).

evidence.claim: Cardholder has 56 historical transactions averaging $61.17 over the observed window.

Flagged transaction 3581141 was an online purchase of $30.02 in billing region 203.0 — deviating from customer's primary billing region 330.0 (59% of baseline activity) with an address mismatch (id_12=NotFound).
Identity fingerprint for txn 3581141 shows DeviceType=desktop, id_12=NotFound (address mismatch), id_34=match_status:2 (partial identity match), suggesting compromised credentials.
Cardholder explicitly states they did not make this purchase and still has the card, consistent with card-not-present compromise.

Post-flagging velocity anomaly: 9 additional transactions totaling $330.12 occurred within 72 hours after the flagged purchase, with amounts clustering at $20 and $50 — classic card testing / enumeration pattern.
Historical closed case CC-2166 (C01521, card_not_present_new_device, $1,497.42 exposure, 24 txns) shows matching pattern — customer dispute, online purchases from unrecognized device.
Historical closed case CC-2761 (C04034, card_not_present_new_device, $939.48 exposure, 43 txns) shows matching pattern — rapid online purchase bursts from SM-A510M device.
Bank Policy R2: Customer-reported unauthorized purchase triggers mandatory card block and case creation when cardholder denies authorization.

case.summary: Investigation of flagged transaction 3581141 on card C08299-K1 identified card-not-present fraud with assessed fraud probability of 0.78. Customer C08299 reported an unrecognized $30.02 online purchase. Post-flag analysis revealed 9 additional unauthorized transactions within 72 hours totaling $330.12, exhibiting a classic card testing/enumeration pattern. Device fingerprint shows partial identity match and address mismatch. Total exposure: $360.14. Historical closed cases CC-2166 and CC-2761 confirm matching CNP fraud pattern. Recommended: card block, full reimbursement, SAR filing, and account monitoring.
